title: Check: Atomic Number and Mass Number (2)

questions.stem: In atomic notation, where is the mass number written?

options.text: To the right of the chemical symbol

questions.explanation: In atomic notation (nuclide notation), the mass number (A) is written as a superscript above or to the upper left of the chemical symbol, and the atomic number (Z) is written below it.

questions.stem: An atom of potassium has 19 protons and 20 neutrons. What is its mass number?
questions.explanation: The mass number is the total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus. For this potassium atom: mass number = 19 protons + 20 neutrons = 39.
